top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation is a new chemical principle (event-driven, catalytic removal by induced proximity), reproduced widely. Crews and Deshaies conceived and demonstrated the concept, and Handa's identification of cereblon explains the thalidomide-type glues, the one strand already attached to approved drugs, so the citation covers both mechanisms and answers the maturity objection. P001 (Ciulli instead of Handa) is the same science with a narrower citation and is my close second.
